description:
Register an HTTPS endpoint of yours that eno will POST signed events to when this shop's listings are created, updated, change status or are deleted.

The address must be public: one reachable only inside your own network is refused with `invalid_input`. A shop can have up to 10 webhooks (`limit_reached` after that), and each call registers a new one, even for an address already registered.

Returns `webhook` with its `id`, `url`, `events`, `enabled`, `created_at` and signing `secret`, shown only this once: store it to verify each event's signature. Use list_webhooks to see them all and delete_webhook to remove one.

events.description: Which changes to be told about, by event name: listing.created, listing.updated, listing.status_changed (e.g. sold or hidden) or listing.deleted. Leave it out to receive every event

url.description: Your public HTTPS address that will receive each event as a signed POST; an address reachable only inside your own network is refused

name: register_webhook

webhook.description: The webhook just registered, with the signing secret you must store now

created_at.description: When the webhook was registered, which is now, as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp; list_webhooks shows it with its delivery history later

enabled.description: true: eno sends events to this address from now on. It turns false only after 15 failed deliveries in a row, which list_webhooks then shows

events.description: The events it will receive, as you chose them; ["*"] means every event

items.description: One event: listing.created (a new listing), listing.updated (an edit), listing.status_changed (sold, hidden or back on sale), listing.deleted; "*" alone means every event

id.description: The new webhook's id; pass it to delete_webhook to stop the events, and list_webhooks shows its delivery health later

secret.description: The signing secret, shown only this once: store it now in your own system to verify each event's signature; eno cannot show it again

url.description: The HTTPS address eno will POST each event to, signed with the secret below, exactly as you gave it to register_webhook

title: Register webhook
